derived.activeFpsPreset: '24' if outputFpsText == '24' else ('30' if outputFpsText == '30' else ('60' if outputFpsText == '60' else ('120' if outputFpsText == '120' else 'none')))

notes: 1. FormatSpeed is not defined as a formula anywhere in S2/S3. From OutputSettings.outputFpsText.description ("小数 2 桁まで・末尾の 0 を除く") and Clip.fpsText.description (same words), I wrote FormatSpeed(x) as num(x, 2). The rounding rule of FormatSpeed at the 2nd decimal is not stated; num rounds half away from zero, so that choice is mine (S2 uses 偶数丸め elsewhere, e.g. Region.speed, but never says it for FormatSpeed).
2. OutputSettings.outputFps.initial "ソースの fps(サンプル: 30)" -> state outputFps = src (Clip.fps is src). The sample value 30 is not written; the opened clip's rate is used.

3. Buttons from operation_definitions SetFps.effect "outputFps を、source ならソースの fps、数値ならその値にし": Source -> outputFps = src; 24/30/60/120 -> outputFps = that number (param of EL-INS-FPS-SOURCE is "source", of EL-INS-FPS-24..120 the numbers 24/30/60/120). The rest of the effect "値が同じでも未保存の変更にする" (unsaved-changes flag) is not written: no slot observes it and its opening value is outside the frame-rate part.

4. OutputSettings.activeFpsPreset.initial "派生: outputFpsText と一致する数字" (type enum{24,30,60,120,none}): I read "一致" as the text outputFpsText being equal to the preset's digits ('24','30','60','120'), else none. So e.g. outputFps 23.996 (text '24') selects 24. V3-V6 (EL-INS-FPS-24..120 "activeFpsPreset が N なら選択の表示") = activeFpsPreset == 'N'.

5. OutputSettings.fpsSourceActive.initial "|outputFps − Clip.fps| < 0.05" -> abs(outputFps - src) < 0.05, copied as written; V2 = it (EL-INS-FPS-SOURCE "fpsSourceActive なら選択の表示"). Source and a number preset can both be shown selected; the design says nothing against it, so nothing is added.
6. OutputSettings.fpsUpsampling.initial "outputFps > Clip.fps + 0.05" -> outputFps > src + 0.05; V7 = it (EL-INS-FPS-NOTE "表示されるのは OutputSettings.fpsUpsampling のとき").

7. V1: EL-EX-SUMMARY-FPS shows outputFpsText, and its text "常に(「{表記} fps」)" with outputFpsText.description "ダイアログの「{表記} fps」" gives the shown form: outputFpsText + ' fps' (outputFpsText itself is only FormatSpeed(outputFps), without ' fps').

8. V8: fpsSourceTip.initial is "派生: Clip.fpsText" while its description and EL-INS-FPS-SOURCE say the tooltip is "Same as source ({fps} fps)". Clip.fpsText is FormatSpeed(fps) + " fps" (= the "{fps} fps" part), so I wrote the tooltip as 'Same as source (' + Clip.fpsText + ')' -> e.g. "Same as source (30 fps)", not adding a second ' fps'.
9. Clip.fpsText.initial "FormatSpeed(fps) + \" fps\"" -> num(src, 2) + ' fps' (derived clipFpsText), with FormatSpeed as in note 1.

10. Not written: the reachability conditions in the enabled_when of EL-INS-FPS-* (modal overlay shown, error banner covering the button). The specimen has no such state; every press is taken as reaching the button.
